steps.title: Act on the Oct 24 deadlines
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file in CAPE for MH3-7844589-8, which appears eligible, and to file protests for MH3-8879176-4 and MH3-8887739-0. The listed amounts are $6,450.00, $1,963.00, and $1,255.00, respectively.

steps.title: File the next CAPE entries
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file in CAPE for these entries, which appear eligible, before their deadlines.

steps.title: File the next protest
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file a protest for MH3-5093576-0 by its deadline; the engine says CAPE is not the route for this entry.

steps.title: File the next protest
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file a protest for MH3-9708001-4 by its deadline.

steps.title: Handle the November protest deadlines
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file protests for these entries by their individual deadlines. The engine identifies the protest route for each.

steps.title: Withdraw the protest, then use CAPE
steps.detail: For MH3-5397498-2, ask your broker to confirm and withdraw the protest if it was filed only for the IEEPA refund, then submit the entry in CAPE.

steps.title: Correct the entry, then use CAPE
steps.detail: For MH3-9005801-3, ask your broker to move the goods value from the Chapter 99 line to the Chapter 1–97 line, then file in CAPE.

steps.title: Meet the late-December deadlines
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file in CAPE for MH3-3663534-3 and file a protest for MH3-6919989-3 by their respective deadlines.

steps.title: Handle the January 9–11 deadlines
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file a protest for MH3-8367202-1 and file in CAPE for MH3-6820604-6 and MH3-8628656-4 by their individual deadlines.

steps.title: Handle the remaining January protest deadlines
steps.detail: Ask your broker to file protests for these entries by their individual deadlines.

Hello,

Please review Meridian Home Goods Co.'s IEEPA entries and confirm the route and filing status for each. The rules-engine results show these immediate deadlines:

Please also confirm the November and January protest deadlines, the CAPE deadlines through Jan 10, 2027, and the steps for MH3-5397498-2 (withdraw protest, then CAPE) and MH3-9005801-3 (correct the value line, then CAPE).

Please advise how CBP is treating the broker-review entries, including MH3-6191079-5 and MH3-9692647-6, and confirm the status and appropriate next steps for MH3-2222500-3 and entries with an open protest or court-related status. Please also confirm the complete entry list and any CAPE-ready file before filing.

Thank you,
[Your name]
Meridian Home Goods Co.
